allow: Bash(.venv/Scripts/python -c "from src.main import app; print\('imports OK'\); print\('rotas:', [r.path for r in app.routes]\)")
Bash(./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "from src.main import app; print\('routes:', sorted\({r.path for r in app.routes if hasattr\(r,'path'\)}\)\)")

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port=$_.LocalPort; PID=$_.OwningProcess; Name=$p.Name; Started=$p.StartTime; CmdPath=$p.Path } } | Format-List; Write-Output "--- node processes ---"; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List)

PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 15000 -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $stillUp = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($stillUp\) { Write-Output "porta 3001 ainda ocupada por PID $\($stillUp.OwningProcess\)" } else { Write-Output "porta 3001 livre" })

PowerShell($ok=$false; for \($i=0; $i -lt 15; $i++\) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3001/api/docs-json -TimeoutSec 3; $paths = $r.paths.PSObject.Properties.Name; if \($paths.Count -gt 1\) { Write-Output \("rotas: " + $paths.Count\); $paths | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; $ok=$true; break } } catch {} }; if \(-not $ok\) { Write-Output "TIMEOUT - API nao subiu com rotas" })

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime, @{n='CommandLine';e={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)

PowerShell($ok=$false; for\($i=0;$i -lt 20;$i++\){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; $ok=$true; break } catch { if\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\){ $ok=$true; break } ; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if\($ok\){"API responding on 3001"}else{"API not responding yet"})

PowerShell($ok=$false; for\($i=0;$i -lt 30;$i++\){ try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/docs" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 | Out-Null; $ok=$true; break } catch { if\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\){ $ok=$true; break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if\($ok\){"API up on 3001"}else{"still down"})
